tagline: Four classes, one invite, one dungeon. No server.
description:
Send the Invite in the bar above. Extra adventurers drop into the same dungeon — warrior, valkyrie, wizard, elf. There is no lobby, no account, and no game server. The room is the link.

On your own it is Jake Gordon's HTML5 Gauntlet: pick a class, shoot the generators, grab the key, find the exit. Health ticks down on its own. Potions clear the room.

On a phone the pad sits under your thumbs — move, fire, potion. On a computer it is the arrows, space, and enter. Your high score and how far you got live in the file.

An unofficial port of HTML5 Gauntlet by Jake Gordon, MIT-licensed. This copy adds the extra adventurers. The dungeon is silent: the original music was licensed only for that project.
